Ridgeline Parka

A three-layer waterproof shell rated to minus twenty, built for days that start cold and get worse. Fully taped seams, pit zips that open one-handed, and a hood that fits over a climbing helmet without pulling the collar off your chin.

It weighs 820 grams in a medium, which is not the lightest shell you can buy. We chose the heavier face fabric because the lighter one wore through at the shoulders inside two seasons of pack use. If you want a shell for fair-weather hiking, this is more jacket than you need.

340 USD. Sizes XS to XXL, cut long in the body.
